test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question: If Z = Y > R = M and G > H = Z = Q, then which of the following options is NOT correct?
solution:
**Given : **Z = Y > R = M and G > H = Z = Q

On combining Z = Y > R = M , G > H = Z = Q

1) G > Q [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3cc172aabbbe72a02bfbfc910d2f671a745d52a63f4b500c68f3dfa230a8525.png] True ( G > H = Z = Q makes G > Q ) 

2) Q > R [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3cc172aabbbe72a02bfbfc910d2f671a745d52a63f4b500c68f3dfa230a8525.png] True (Q = Z = Y > R makes Q > R ) 

3) R > Z [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3cc172aabbbe72a02bfbfc910d2f671a745d52a63f4b500c68f3dfa230a8525.png] False (Z = Y > R = M doesn't make R > Z ) 

4) H = Y [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3cc172aabbbe72a02bfbfc910d2f671a745d52a63f4b500c68f3dfa230a8525.png] True (H = Z = Y makes H = Y ) 

Hence, **Option 3)** is the correct answer.
